SELECT id AS calendar_event_id, streamer_id, platform_account_id, event_type, status FROM calendar_events WHERE id = #{calendarEventId} AND streamer_id = #{streamerId}

INSERT INTO broadcast_sessions ( streamer_id, platform_account_id, calendar_event_id, title, category, language, status, started_at ) VALUES ( #{session.streamerId}, #{session.platformAccountId}, #{session.calendarEventId}, #{session.title}, #{session.category}, #{session.language}, 'PREPARING', #{session.startedAt} ) RETURNING id
mapper.sql: id, streamer_id, platform_account_id, calendar_event_id, title, category, language, thumbnail_url, vod_url, status, started_at, ended_at, created_at, updated_at

mapper.sql: s.id AS session_id, s.platform_account_id, s.calendar_event_id, s.title, s.category, s.language, s.thumbnail_url, s.vod_url, s.status, s.started_at, s.ended_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM broadcast_sessions s WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND s.status IN ('PREPARING', 'LIVE') ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1

WITH viewer AS ( SELECT round(avg(viewer_count))::int AS average_viewers, max(viewer_count) AS peak_viewers FROM viewer_metrics WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ), chat AS ( SELECT count(*) AS total_chat, count(sentiment_label) AS analyzed_chat, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'JOY') AS joy_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'EXCITEMENT') AS excitement_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SUPPORT') AS support_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SURPRISE') AS surprise_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SADNESS') AS sadness_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'ANGER') AS anger_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'CONFUSION') AS confusion_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'NEUTRAL') AS neutral_count FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ) SELECT v.average_viewers, v.peak_viewers, c.total_chat, c.analyzed_chat, c.joy_count, c.excitement_count, c.support_count, c.surprise_count, c.sadness_count, c.anger_count, c.confusion_count, c.neutral_count FROM viewer v CROSS JOIN chat c
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET avg_viewers = #{statistics.averageViewers}, peak_viewers = #{statistics.peakViewers}, total_chat = #{statistics.totalChat}, analyzed_chat = #{statistics.analyzedChat}, joy_count = #{statistics.joyCount}, excitement_count = #{statistics.excitementCount}, support_count = #{statistics.supportCount}, surprise_count = #{statistics.surpriseCount}, sadness_count = #{statistics.sadnessCount}, anger_count = #{statistics.angerCount}, confusion_count = #{statistics.confusionCount}, neutral_count = #{statistics.neutralCount} WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE reports SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
